# Pipette v0.7.0 - Table of Contents

Declarative Buildkite pipeline generation for monorepos, written in Elixir

## Pages

- [Pipette](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

- Guides
  - [Getting Started](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/getting-started.md)
  - [Production Example](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/production-example.md)

  - [Targeting](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/targeting.md)
  - [Dynamic Groups](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/dynamic-groups.md)
  - [Testing](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/testing.md)

## Modules

- [Pipette](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.md): Declarative Buildkite pipeline generation for monorepos, written in Elixir.
- [Pipette.Optional](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Optional.md): Marks a `depends_on` reference as optional.
- [Pipette.Pipeline](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Pipeline.md): Pipeline configuration struct.
- [Pipette.ScopeRef](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.ScopeRef.md): A reference to a named scope within a group.

- Pipeline Definition
  - [Pipette.Branch](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Branch.md): Branch policy for activation.
  - [Pipette.Constructors](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Constructors.md): Convenience constructors for building pipeline structs at runtime.
  - [Pipette.DSL](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.DSL.md): Declarative Buildkite pipeline definition DSL.
  - [Pipette.Group](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Group.md): Group of Buildkite steps.
  - [Pipette.Info](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Info.md): Accessor functions for reading pipeline configuration from Spark DSL modules.
  - [Pipette.Scope](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Scope.md): File-affinity scope for activation.
  - [Pipette.Step](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Step.md): Buildkite command step.
  - [Pipette.Trigger](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Trigger.md): Buildkite trigger step that starts another pipeline.

- DSL Internals
  - [Pipette.Dsl.Transformers.GenerateKeys](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Dsl.Transformers.GenerateKeys.md): Compile-time transformer that derives Buildkite key strings for
groups, steps, and triggers.
  - [Pipette.Dsl.Verifiers.ValidateAcyclic](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Dsl.Verifiers.ValidateAcyclic.md): Validates that group dependencies form a DAG (no cycles).
  - [Pipette.Dsl.Verifiers.ValidateRefs](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Dsl.Verifiers.ValidateRefs.md): Validates that scope, depends_on, and force_activate references are valid.
  - [Pipette.Dsl.Verifiers.ValidateSteps](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Dsl.Verifiers.ValidateSteps.md): Validates step and trigger configuration constraints inside groups.

- Engine
  - [Pipette.Activation](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Activation.md): The activation engine — determines which groups and steps should run.
  - [Pipette.Context](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Context.md): Runtime context built from Buildkite environment variables.
  - [Pipette.Git](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Git.md): Git change detection and glob matching for pipeline activation.
  - [Pipette.Graph](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Graph.md): Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) for pipeline dependency management.
  - [Pipette.Target](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Target.md): Parses pipeline targets from commit messages and the `CI_TARGET` environment variable.

- Output
  - [Pipette.Buildkite](https://buildkite-pipette.hexdocs.pm/Pipette.Buildkite.md): Serializes pipeline groups/steps to Buildkite YAML format.
